mapper.select: SELECT STORE_ID, STORE_NAME, BUSINESS_NO, STORE_INTRO, DELIVERY_YN, IS_CHAT_ENABLED, CHAT_START, CHAT_END, STORE_ADDR, STORE_AREA, STORE_PASS, REJECT_REASON, GRADE_CODE, MEMBERSHIP, REG_DATE, UDATE FROM SELLER_INFO_TBL WHERE USER_ID = #{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND STORE_PASS = 'P' ORDER BY STORE_ID
mapper.update: UPDATE SELLER_INFO_TBL SET IS_CHAT_ENABLED = #{isChatEnabled}, CHAT_START = #{chatStart}, CHAT_END = #{chatEnd}, UDATE = SYSDATE WHERE STORE_ID = #{storeId}
mapper.select: SELECT s.STORE_NAME, TO_CHAR(o.ORDER_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') AS ORDER_MONTH, COUNT(o.ORDER_ID) AS ORDER_COUNT, SUM(o.TOTAL_PRICE) AS TOTAL_SALES FROM SELLER_INFO_TBL s JOIN ORDER_TBL o ON s.STORE_NAME = o.STORE_NAME WHERE s.USER_ID = #{userId} GROUP BY s.STORE_NAME, TO_CHAR(o.ORDER_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY ORDER_MONTH

SELECT TO_CHAR(o.order_date, 'MM') AS MONTH, SUM(o.total_price) AS TOTAL FROM order_tbl o INNER JOIN seller_info_tbl s ON o.store_name = s.store_name WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY TO_CHAR(o.order_date, 'MM') ORDER BY TO_CHAR(o.order_date, 'MM')

SELECT T1.USER_NAME, T2.ORDER_ID, MAX(T3.PRO_NAME) AS PRO_NAME, MAX(T4.OPTION_NAME) AS OPTION_NAME, MAX(T5.VALUE_NAME) AS VALUE_NAME, MAX(T3.PRICE) AS PRICE, MAX(T6.PRICE_DIFF) AS PRICE_DIFF, COALESCE(MAX(T9.PICKUP_DATE), MAX(T2.ORDER_DATE)) AS PICKUP_DELIVERY_DATE, MAX(T10.STORE_NAME) AS STORE_NAME FROM ORDER_TBL T2 JOIN USER_TBL T1 ON T2.USER_ID = T1.USER_ID JOIN ORDER_DETAIL_TBL T3 ON T2.ORDER_ID = T3.ORDER_ID JOIN PRODUCT_TBL T8 ON T3.PRO_NO = T8.PRO_NO JOIN SELLER_INFO_TBL T10 ON T8.STORE_ID = T10.STORE_ID LEFT JOIN ORDER_OPTION_TBL T6 ON T3.ORDER_DETAIL_ID = T6.ORDER_DETAIL_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_OPTION_TBL T4 ON T6.TOP_OPTION_ID = T4.TOP_OPTION_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_SUB_OPTION_TBL T5 ON T6.SUB_OPTION_ID = T5.SUB_OPTION_ID LEFT JOIN DELIVERY_TBL T7 ON T2.ORDER_ID = T7.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN PICKUP_TBL T9 ON T2.ORDER_ID = T9.ORDER_ID WHERE T10.USER_ID = #{userId} GROUP BY T1.USER_NAME, T2.ORDER_ID ORDER BY T2.ORDER_ID

SELECT T1.USER_NAME, T2.ORDER_ID, T3.PRO_NAME, COALESCE(T9.PICKUP_DATE, T2.ORDER_DATE), T10.STORE_NAME, T3.PRICE, SUM(NVL(T6.PRICE_DIFF, 0)), LISTAGG(T4.OPTION_NAME || ': ' || T5.VALUE_NAME, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY T6.ORDER_OPTION_ID), T2.CHAT_YN FROM ORDER_TBL T2 JOIN USER_TBL T1 ON T2.USER_ID = T1.USER_ID JOIN ORDER_DETAIL_TBL T3 ON T2.ORDER_ID = T3.ORDER_ID JOIN PRODUCT_TBL T8 ON T3.PRO_NO = T8.PRO_NO JOIN SELLER_INFO_TBL T10 ON T8.STORE_ID = T10.STORE_ID LEFT JOIN ORDER_OPTION_TBL T6 ON T3.ORDER_DETAIL_ID = T6.ORDER_DETAIL_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_OPTION_TBL T4 ON T6.TOP_OPTION_ID = T4.TOP_OPTION_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_SUB_OPTION_TBL T5 ON T6.SUB_OPTION_ID = T5.SUB_OPTION_ID LEFT JOIN DELIVERY_TBL T7 ON T2.ORDER_ID = T7.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN PICKUP_TBL T9 ON T2.ORDER_ID = T9.ORDER_ID WHERE T2.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} GROUP BY T1.USER_NAME, T2.ORDER_ID, T3.PRO_NAME, T3.PRICE, COALESCE(T9.PICKUP_DATE, T2.ORDER_DATE), T10.STORE_NAME, T2.CHAT_YN
SELECT MSG_ID, CHAT_ID, ORDER_ID, USER_ID, STORE_ID, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(MESSAGE, 4000, 1) AS MESSAGE, MESSAGE_TYPE, SENT_AT, IS_READ FROM CHAT_MSG_TBL WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId} ORDER BY SENT_AT ASC
mapper.insert: SELECT CHAT_MSG_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL INSERT INTO CHAT_MSG_TBL ( MSG_ID, CHAT_ID, ORDER_ID, USER_ID, STORE_ID, MESSAGE, MESSAGE_TYPE, SENT_AT, IS_READ ) VALUES ( #{msgId}, (SELECT CHAT_ID FROM CHAT_TBL WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId}), #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{storeId}, <choose> <when test="messageType == 'IMAGE'">#{filePath}</when> <otherwise>#{message}</otherwise> </choose> , #{messageType}, SYSDATE, 'N' )
mapper.update: UPDATE CHAT_TBL SET LAST_MSG_AT = SYSDATE, LAST_MSG = <choose> <when test="messageType == 'IMAGE'">이미지를 보냈습니다.</when> <otherwise>SUBSTR(#{message},1,200)</otherwise> </choose> , UNREAD_COUNT = UNREAD_COUNT + 1 WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
UPDATE CHAT_MSG_TBL SET IS_READ = 'Y' WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND IS_READ = 'N'
mapper.select:
SELECT R.REVIEW_ID, R.ORDER_ID, R.RATING, DBMS_LOB.SUBSTR(R.REVIEW_CONTENT) AS REVIEW_CONTENT, R.CDATETIME, R.USER_ID, S.STORE_ID, S.STORE_NAME, S.USER_ID AS 판매자_ID FROM REVIEW_TBL R JOIN SELLER_INFO_TBL S ON R.STORE_ID = S.STORE_ID
WHERE S.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY R.CDATETIME DESC
mapper.update:
UPDATE ORDER_TBL SET ADD_OPTION_PRICE = NVL(#{addOptionPrice}, 0), LETTERING_WORD = #{letteringWord}, STATUS = 'C'
WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
mapper.select: SELECT P.ORDER_ID, TO_CHAR(P.PICKUP_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PICKUP_START_DATE, TO_CHAR(P.PICKUP_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PICKUP_END_DATE FROM PICKUP_TBL P JOIN SELLER_INFO_TBL S ON P.STORE_ADDR = S.STORE_ADDR WHERE S.USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT U.USER_ID, U.USER_NAME, U.EMAIL, U.USER_ADDR, U.PHONE, U.ROLE, U.USER_STATUS, U.JOIN_CDATE, U.UDATE, S.STORE_ID, S.STORE_NAME, S.BUSINESS_NO, S.STORE_INTRO, S.DELIVERY_YN, S.IS_CHAT_ENABLED, S.CHAT_START, S.CHAT_END, S.STORE_ADDR, S.MEMBERSHIP FROM USER_TBL U JOIN SELLER_INFO_TBL S ON U.USER_ID = S.USER_ID WHERE U.USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT U.USER_ID, U.USER_NAME, U.EMAIL, U.USER_ADDR, U.PHONE, U.ROLE, U.USER_STATUS, U.JOIN_CDATE, U.UDATE, S.STORE_ID, S.STORE_NAME, S.BUSINESS_NO, S.STORE_INTRO, S.DELIVERY_YN, S.IS_CHAT_ENABLED, S.CHAT_START, S.CHAT_END, S.STORE_ADDR, S.MEMBERSHIP FROM USER_TBL U JOIN SELLER_INFO_TBL S ON U.USER_ID = S.USER_ID WHERE U.USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.update:
UPDATE USER_TBL
USER_PASS = #{userPass},
USER_NAME = #{userName},
EMAIL = #{email},
USER_ADDR = #{userAddr},
PHONE = #{phone}, UDATE = SYSDATE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}

UPDATE SELLER_INFO_TBL
STORE_NAME = #{storeName},
STORE_INTRO = #{storeIntro},
STORE_ADDR = #{storeAddr},
DELIVERY_YN = #{deliveryYN}, IS_CHAT_ENABLED = #{isChatEnabled}, CHAT_START = #{chatStart}, CHAT_END = #{chatEnd}, MEMBERSHIP = #{membership}, UDATE = SYSDATE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.PRO_NO, -- 상품 번호 p.PRO_NAME, -- 상품명 p.PRO_TYPE, -- 상품 종류 p.PRICE, -- 가격 p.STATUS, -- 현재 상태 q.QUESTION_ID, -- 질문 ID q.QUESTION_CONTENT, -- 질문 내용 q.QUESTION_DATE, -- 질문 작성일 q.ANSWER_CONTENT, -- 답변 내용 q.ANSWER_DATE, -- 답변일 s.STORE_NAME, -- 가게 이름 s.STORE_ADDR -- 가게 주소 FROM QA_TBL q JOIN PRODUCT_TBL p ON q.PRO_NO = p.PRO_NO JOIN SELLER_INFO_TBL s ON p.STORE_ID = s.STORE_ID WHERE s.USER_ID = #{userId} -- 로그인한 사용자 ID AND p.STORE_NAME = s.STORE_NAME -- 해당 상품이 로그인한 유저의 가게에 속하는지 확인 -- 스윗디저트 가게의 소유자가 로그인한 유저인지 확인 ORDER BY q.QUESTION_DATE DESC -- 질문 작성일 기준 내림차순 정렬
mapper.update: UPDATE QA_TBL SET ANSWER_CONTENT = #{answerContent}, ANSWER_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE QUESTION_ID = #{questionId}
